overall.basis: It is set against what has been written down somewhere checkable, not against everything that has happened. Three things hold it down: whole scopes have had no research round yet, several of them large ones; countries whose courts and press do not publish leave almost nothing to find, so the thinnest parts of the map are the places where the most is likely going on; and the registers below, where someone has counted, show how much sits behind a single surfaced case.
